topic: Developmental milestones you must know by age

slides.title: Milestones Every Medico Must Know
slides.subtitle: High-yield Gross, Fine Motor, Language & Social guide for NEET-PG

slides.title: 0 to 6 Months: Early Infancy
slides.subtitle: Head control & social smile
points: 6–8 weeks: Social smile appears; fixes & follows light
3–4 months: Steady head control; coos & laughs aloud
4 months: Bidextrous reach; rolls prone to supine
6 months: Sits with support; transfers objects
6 months: Monosyllabic babble; stranger anxiety starts
slides.highlight: Exam pearl: Palmar grasp comes at 6m; pincer grasp is at 9–12m!

slides.title: 9 to 12 Months: Late Infancy
slides.subtitle: Sitting, pincer grasp & first words
points: 9 months: Sits steadily without support; crawls
9 months: Immature pincer grasp; waves bye-bye
9 months: Object permanence; bisyllabic mama/dada
12 months: Stands without support; walks with 1 hand held
12 months: Mature pincer grasp; 1–2 meaningful words
slides.highlight: Red flag: Not sitting by 9 months or no babbling by 12 months.

slides.title: 15 to 24 Months: Toddlerhood
slides.subtitle: Walking, towers & 2-word phrases
points: 15 months: Walks alone; tower of 2–3 cubes; scribbles
18 months: Runs stiffly; tower of 3–4 cubes; 10+ words
18 months: Feeds with spoon; domestic mimicry
24 months: Runs well; climbs stairs 2 feet/step
24 months: Tower of 6–7 cubes; 2-word sentences

slides.title: 3 to 5 Years: Preschool Years
slides.subtitle: Tricycle, shapes & self-care
points: 3 years: Rides tricycle; copies circle; 9–10 cubes
3 years: Knows full name, age & gender; 3-word sentences
4 years: Hops on 1 foot; copies cross (+); tells stories
4.5 years: Copies square; cooperative group play
5 years: Skips; copies triangle; dresses independently
slides.highlight: Exam pearl: Circle = 3y, Cross = 4y, Square = 4.5y, Triangle = 5y.

slides.title: Tower vs Drawing Cheat Sheet
slides.subtitle: Age & Cubes || Shape Copied
points: 15 months: 2–3 cubes || Spontaneous scribbling
18 months: 3–4 cubes || Imitates vertical stroke
2 years: 6–7 cubes || Copies vertical/circular stroke
3 years: 9–10 cubes || Copies a circle
4 years: Cuts with scissors || Copies a cross (+)
5 years: Gate of 5 cubes || Copies a triangle
slides.highlight: Exam pearl: Bridge of 3 cubes at 3 yrs; Gate of 5 cubes at 5 yrs.

slides.title: DELAYS
slides.subtitle: Red flags: when NOT to 'wait & watch'
points: D - Delayed head holding beyond 4 months
E - Eye contact / social smile absent at 3 months
L - Loss of any acquired skill at any age
A - Absent independent sitting by 9 months
Y - Year (1 yr): no babbling/pointing; no words by 16m
S - Speaking no 2-word phrases by 24m; no walk by 18m
slides.highlight: Red flag: Regression of milestones is ALWAYS an urgent red flag!

slides.title: High-Yield Exam Pearls
slides.subtitle: Must-know rules for clinics & MCQs
points: Use corrected age for preterms (<37 wks) until 2 years
Handedness before 18 months is abnormal (check for hemiplegia)
DQ = (Dev Age / Chron Age) × 100; <70 indicates delay
GDD requires significant delay in ≥2 developmental domains
slides.highlight: Exam pearl: Corrected age = Chronological age − Weeks of prematurity.

caption:
Developmental milestones show up in EVERY Paediatrics viva and NEET-PG paper—and it's so easy to mix up 15m vs 18m!

Here's your complete, high-yield cheat sheet from 6 weeks to 5 years:
✅ Gross motor, fine motor, language & social milestones
✅ Tower of cubes vs drawing shapes comparison
✅ The DELAYS mnemonic for urgent red flags
✅ Corrected age & DQ formulas for preterms

Quick quiz for the comments 👇 At what age does a child build a gate of 5 cubes and copy a triangle?

Save 🔖 & share with a batchmate

For education only; follow local protocols.
references: Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics, 21st Edition (Growth, Development, and Behavior)
Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) Consensus Guidelines on Developmental Surveillance & Screening
American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) / CDC Developmental Milestones & Surveillance Guidelines
Ghai Essential Pediatrics, 10th Edition (Normal Growth and Development)
doctor_check: Social smile: 6–8 weeks (Ghai/IAP cites 6 weeks; Nelson Table 23-1 cites 2 months).
Head control: 3–4 months (Nelson: holds head steady when sitting at 4 months; Ghai: neck holding at 3 months).
Rolling over: 4 months prone to supine (supine to prone by 5–6 months).
Sitting: with support at 6 months; steadily without support by 8–9 months (Nelson median 6–7m; CDC 2022 75th percentile 9m; Ghai 8m).
Pincer grasp: immature ~9 months, mature ~12 months.
Towers: 15m (2–3 cubes), 18m (3–4 cubes), 24m (6–7 cubes), 3y (9–10 cubes), bridge of 3 cubes (3y), gate of 5 cubes (5y).
Drawing/copying: 15m scribbles, 18m imitates vertical stroke, 2y copies vertical/circular stroke, 3y circle, 4y cross (+), 4.5y square, 5y triangle.
Language: 6m monosyllabic babble, 9m bisyllabic (mama/dada non-specific), 12m 1–2 meaningful words, 18m 10+ words, 24m 50+ words & 2-word phrases, 3y 3-word sentences.

Red flags (AAP/IAP): no eye contact/social smile by 3m, no head control by 4m, not sitting without support by 9m, no babbling/pointing by 12m, no single words by 16m, not walking by 18m, no 2-word phrases by 24m, loss of any skill at any age.
Preterm correction: adjust for prematurity (<37 weeks gestation) up to 24 months (2 years) of chronological age.
Handedness before 18 months: abnormal (evaluate for hemiplegia).
DQ cut-off: <70 indicates developmental delay; GDD defined as significant delay in >=2 domains.
